description: Finds items (materials, battle records, chips, furniture, event items) by name in any language (zh, en, ja, ko), by alias or nickname (土块, 狗粮), by pinyin (guyuanyan) or by item ID, and returns their item IDs (get_item_drop_rates takes a name too; search first when unsure which item is meant) and names in every language. Best matches first: exact before prefix before substring, names before aliases. Several items can share an alias (石头 is each tier of Orirock): ambiguous is then true; ask the user which one is meant or decide by context. Items of other types (workshop-crafted materials such as D32 Steel, recruitment tags) are returned only when no listed item matches, with a note saying what they are.

lang.description: Language of the names in the result: the language the user writes in, zh, en, ja or ko (en for other languages, and if omitted).

limit.description: Most items to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

query.description: Name, alias, pinyin or ID of the item, in any language: 固源岩, Orirock Cube, 石头, guyuanyan or 30012

name: search_items

ambiguous.description: Whether several items match as well as the first (an alias of several items, such as 石头 for the four tiers of Orirock): ask which one is meant, or pick by context, rather than take the first

note.description: Set when no item of a listed type matched and the results are items of other types: what those are

results.description: The items found, best match first

existsOn.description: Game servers the item exists on

matchType.description: How matchedText matched the query: exact, prefix or substring

matchedBy.description: What matched the query: id, name (in any language), alias (a nickname in zh or ja), pinyin (a reading in zh) or romaji (a reading in ja)

name.description: Name in the language asked for

pageUrl.description: Page of the drop rates of the item on Penguin Statistics, on CN or else the first server it exists on; null if it exists on none; null for an item of another type

rarity.description: Rarity as stored, 0 to 4: the tier of the item in the game minus 1

type.description: MATERIAL, CARD_EXP (battle records), CHIP, FURN (furniture) or ACTIVITY_ITEM (event items); with a note, another type: ARKPLANNER (crafted in the workshop), RECRUIT_TAG (a recruitment tag), TEMP or LGG_SHD

attribution.description: The credit to give wherever this data is used

url.description: The page of this data on Penguin Statistics, or its home page

truncated.description: Whether more items match than the limit

title: Search items
